fields.description: Best-record value for the active course: gameplay counter compared and stored only when the new value beats the stored one.
fields.evidence: FUN_0803a37c stores gameplay u16 param_1 (from the DAT_0802ac84 gameplay table via its 0802abxx tick caller) at save-RAM struct+4, gated by param_1 != 0 && stored <= param_1 (best-update gate); file block 2 written by FUN_08046ad0(2, ...). EEPROM driver stores each 8-byte block MSB-first, so logical offset = block_base + ram_off (verified: FUN_080394a0 defaults byte-reversed == baseline).
fields.name: best_record_value

fields.description: Flag byte stored alongside the best record (set by the record-update path).
fields.evidence: FUN_0803a37c stores gameplay byte param_2 at save-RAM struct+7 (file-logical 23) in the same best-update path that writes block 2 via FUN_08046ad0(2, ...); baseline holds the FUN_080394a0 default 0.
fields.name: best_record_flag

fields.description: Performance rank for the stored record: 0 = unranked (default), 1-4 from the rank evaluator.
fields.evidence: FUN_0803a37c stores FUN_0803a7f8() & 0xff at save-RAM struct+2 (file-logical 26); FUN_0803a7f8 returns 1-4 via play-counter thresholds (0x27/0x3b/0x4f on DAT_0803a84c); FUN_08039cb4 no-record branch stores 0 there before the block-3 write via FUN_08046ad0(3, ...). Baseline 0 satisfies 0..4.
fields.name: record_rank

fields.description: Record-slot validity marker, always 1 in every writer path.
fields.evidence: FUN_080394a0 defaults set save-RAM halfword+4 = 1; FUN_08039cb4 no-record branch sets DAT_0803a038[2] = 1 immediately before writing block 3 via FUN_08046ad0(3, ...). Baseline file-logical 28 holds 1.
fields.name: record_slot_valid

fields.description: First gameplay-select byte of the menu/save header (song/course/select slot 0).
fields.evidence: FUN_08039ae0 stores *(DAT_0803d3e8+9) at save-RAM+0 (file-logical 32) and writes block 4 via FUN_08046ad0(4, ...); mirrored by FUN_0803aa20 from DAT_0803d6bc+9 in the FUN_0803d64c menu flow. Baseline 1 equals the FUN_080394a0 default.
fields.name: menu_select_byte_0

fields.description: Second gameplay-select byte of the menu/save header (select slot 1).
fields.evidence: FUN_08039ae0 stores *(DAT_0803d3e8+10) at save-RAM+1 (file-logical 33), block 4 via FUN_08046ad0(4, ...); mirrored by FUN_0803aa20 in FUN_0803d64c. Baseline 1 equals the FUN_080394a0 default.
fields.name: menu_select_byte_1

fields.description: Third gameplay-select byte of the menu/save header (select slot 2).
fields.evidence: FUN_08039ae0 stores *(DAT_0803d3e8+0xb) at save-RAM+2 (file-logical 34), block 4 via FUN_08046ad0(4, ...); mirrored by FUN_0803aa20 in FUN_0803d64c. Baseline 3 equals the FUN_080394a0 default.
fields.name: menu_select_byte_2

fields.description: Fourth gameplay-select byte of the menu/save header (select slot 3).
fields.evidence: FUN_08039ae0 stores *(DAT_0803d3e8+0xc) at save-RAM+3 (file-logical 35), block 4 via FUN_08046ad0(4, ...); mirrored by FUN_0803aa20 in FUN_0803d64c. Baseline 0 equals the FUN_080394a0 default.
fields.name: menu_select_byte_3

fields.description: Mode/option byte saved with the menu header (getter shared by the save and boot flows).
fields.evidence: FUN_08039ae0 stores FUN_0803dc44() (returns *DAT_0803dc4c) at save-RAM+4 (file-logical 36), block 4 via FUN_08046ad0(4, ...); same getter feeds FUN_0803aa20 in FUN_0803d64c. Baseline 0 equals the FUN_080394a0 default.
fields.name: menu_select_mode

fields.description: Menu-header validity marker, always 1 when the header is written.
fields.evidence: FUN_08039ae0 stores 1 at save-RAM+5 (file-logical 37) before writing block 4 via FUN_08046ad0(4, ...); FUN_080394a0 defaults set the same byte to 1. Baseline holds 1.
fields.name: menu_select_valid

fields.description: 32-bit boot-persisted record word copied from a ROM table at save time; consumed by the boot path.
fields.evidence: FUN_0803a608 copies *(DAT_0803a648 + DAT_0803a64c) to save-RAM+0..3 (file-logical 40..43) and writes block 5 via FUN_08046ad0(5, ...); FUN_0803a860 invokes it at boot; FUN_0803a95c reads block 5 back via FUN_08046a20(5, ...) in the FUN_0803dd04 boot sequence. Baseline 0.
fields.name: boot_record_word

fields.description: Stage/song index byte used by the boot-time table loader (1-based selector).
fields.evidence: FUN_0803a608 stores a ROM-table byte at save-RAM+4 (file-logical 44); the boot path FUN_0803dd04 derives it via FUN_0803aa54 into FUN_0803dea4, which indexes a ((sel & 0xff) - 1) * 0xc row table. Baseline 0 (pre-first-play default).
fields.name: boot_stage_index

fields.description: Second boot parameter byte saved with the boot record.
fields.evidence: FUN_0803a608 stores caller param_2 at save-RAM+5 (file-logical 45) and writes block 5 via FUN_08046ad0(5, ...); FUN_0803a860 supplies it from DAT_0803a94c table bytes at boot. Baseline 0.
fields.name: boot_param_b

fields.description: First boot parameter byte saved with the boot record.
fields.evidence: FUN_0803a608 stores caller param_1 at save-RAM+6 (file-logical 46) and writes block 5 via FUN_08046ad0(5, ...); FUN_0803a860 supplies it from DAT_0803a94c table bytes at boot; boot mirrors it via FUN_0803aa54 into FUN_0803dea4. Baseline 0.
fields.name: boot_param_a

fields.description: Boot-record validity marker, always 1 when the boot record is written.
fields.evidence: FUN_0803a608 stores 1 at save-RAM+7 (file-logical 47) before writing block 5 via FUN_08046ad0(5, ...); FUN_080394a0 defaults set the same byte to 1; FUN_0803a95c/FUN_0803dd04 boot path consumes block 5. Baseline holds 1.
fields.name: boot_valid

fields.description: Scratch/error-path slot: the driver writes an 8-byte buffer to EEPROM block 0x3e here (zeros on success paths).
fields.evidence: FUN_08039800 writes 8 bytes to EEPROM block 0x3e (= file 496..503) from every save wrapper (FUN_080394a0, FUN_08039ae0, FUN_08039cb4, FUN_0803a37c, FUN_0803a608); success paths pre-fill zeros via FUN_08046f80. Baseline holds zeros.
fields.name: error_scratch

magic_signatures.description: Title tag 'DSSENKOU' as stored: the EEPROM serial driver persists each 8-byte block MSB-first, so raw file bytes 0-7 read DSSENKOU while the rev8-logical domain reads UOKNESSD.
